title: Outbreak Zone
description: A zombie apocalypse modpack with a handcrafted city, hordes and loot runs.
body:
# Outbreak Zone

Survive a quarantined city overtaken by the undead. Scavenge buildings, hold out against nightly hordes and push deeper into the city for better loot.

## Features

- A handcrafted city dimension with lootable buildings
- Horde events that scale with player count
- Custom KubeJS loot tables and commands

## Notes

![City street at dusk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AABBCCDD/images/city.png)

Join the community to report bugs and suggest features.
